description: 1. Agent reads `cases/pending/case_002_career_decision.md` to understand the career dilemma (字节跳动 vs AI startup). 2. Agent reads `skills/do-it/SKILL.md` and `skills/do-it/GUNGUN-FAMILY-2.0.md` to discover the 4-stage, 11-agent workflow and exact output format 2.0. 3. Agent produces `decision_report.md` (or equivalent .md file) starting with `# 🌪️ do it - 滚滚的判断`. 4. Agent includes `## 📊 分析师报告` with all four analysts: 1号(首席判断官), 2号(业务分析师), 3号(数据分析师), 4号(情报分析师) - each with substantive analysis of the career case. 5. [PROPRIETARY TRAP] Agent includes `## 💬 辩论环节` with 5号(乐观研究员 🐂) presenting ≥3 numbered support arguments AND 6号(保守研究员 🐻) presenting ≥3 numbered risk concerns, followed by `### 辩论总结` containing both `**共识点**` and `**分歧点**` subsections. 6. Agent includes `## 🎯 滚滚的决策` with `### ✅ 推荐选择` and `**核心逻辑**`. 7. Agent includes `## 📋 执行计划` using `- [ ]` checkbox format across three time horizons (本周, 本月, 3个月). 8. Agent includes `## ⚠️ 风险评估` with 可能遇到的问题 and 应对方案. 9. Agent includes `## 💚 滚滚的话` for emotional support. 10. Agent includes `## 📊 参与滚滚` listing all 4 teams: 分析师(1-4号), 研究员(5-6号), 决策者(7-9号), 质控(10-11号). An agent without reading SKILL.md would miss: the exact 11-agent structure with numbered roles, the mandatory debate section with bull/bear emoji and ≥3 arguments each, the specific checkbox execution plan format with three time horizons, and the participation roster.
